observations.text: The existing site repository contains four ORBIT schemas and eight JSON examples.
The existing validation script checks schemas and cross-record references but is coupled to the site repository layout.
The existing source does not yet contain a standalone ORBIT skill package.

criterionAssessments.explanation: The source artefacts exist in the website repository and are being copied into this standard repository. A standalone specification document remains to be written.
The copied validator provides the first bounded validation slice. CI wiring and package boundaries remain to be added.
No standalone ORBIT skills exist in the repository yet.
